explanation.value: Split both sentences into word arrays. Walk through s with one index while a second index j points at the next word of t still to be matched. If the current s word equals t[j], it is matched and j advances; otherwise it is missing and is appended to the result. Because t is guaranteed to be a subsequence, this greedy leftmost matching always consumes all of t.
